entries.title: Suspect killed after opening fire on Secret Service near White House
entries.snippet: Officials say a suspect approached a checkpoint near the building and opened fire, and that a bystander was wounded.

entries.title: Large-scale Russian attack on Ukraine leaves four dead and dozens injured
entries.snippet: The Oreshnik missile, which reportedly travels over 10 times the speed of sound, was used, Russia has confirmed.

entries.title: BBC at the site of China's worst mining disaster in more than a decade
entries.snippet: At least 82 people have been killed after a gas explosion at the Liushenyu mine in China.

entries.title: Blast targeting train kills at least 20 in Pakistan
entries.snippet: Officials say the train had been transporting military personnel home for Eid when it was attacked by armed separatists.

entries.title: Man killed in shark attack off Australia's north-east coast
entries.snippet: The 39-year-old was fatally injured while swimming out at a shoal off the Cassowary Coast in Queensland.

entries.title: California declares emergency as fire crews race to contain toxic leak
entries.snippet: Thousands have been evacuated as officials warn a tank containing about 7,000 gallons of methyl methacrylate could explode.

entries.title: Bolivian minister's convoy ambushed while overseeing roadblock clearance
entries.snippet: Security forces were met by resistance while attempting to clear highway barriers, amid unrest over the government's economic policies.

entries.title: People trapped under collapsed building in Philippines
entries.snippet: A search operation has so far rescued 24 people with no deaths reported at the site, in a city near the capital Manila.

entries.title: Red Cross volunteers die from suspected Ebola in DR Congo
entries.snippet: They are thought to have caught the virus before the outbreak was identified, the Red Cross says.

entries.title: French mum and partner held until trial after sons abandoned by road in Portugal
entries.snippet: The couple, who allegedly left the woman's sons on a roadside in southern Portugal, will remain in custody.

entries.title: F1 great Prost 'injured as masked gang raid home'
entries.snippet: Four-time Formula 1 world champion Alain Prost was injured when a masked gang raided his home near Geneva, Swiss media reports.

entries.title: At least 82 killed in Chinese coal mine explosion
entries.snippet: The blast in Shanxi province constitutes the country's worst mining disaster in 16 years.

entries.title: Nascar champion Kyle Busch died of pneumonia and sepsis, family says
entries.snippet: The driver died aged 41 on Thursday after "overwhelming complications" from the illnesses.

entries.title: Rubio meets Modi during India visit with energy high on agenda
entries.snippet: The secretary of state wants to sell US energy to Delhi to make up for shortfalls caused by the Iran war.

entries.title: Trump says Iran deal 'largely negotiated' including reopening Strait of Hormuz
entries.snippet: Tehran also signals progress on talks but says the key issue of nuclear weapons is not part of an initial framework it is working on.

entries.title: Putin vows retaliation after accusing Ukraine of hitting student dormitory
entries.snippet: Ukraine says it struck Russia's elite Rubicon drone military unit in a Moscow-occupied region.

entries.title: Senegal's president sacks PM and former ally after months-long feud
entries.snippet: Bassirou Diomaye Faye also dissolved the government, creating uncertainty amid a debt crisis in the country.

entries.title: Gaza flotilla activists allege abuse by Israeli forces while detained
entries.snippet: The detainees say they were slapped, hit, humiliated and even subjected to sexual violence, but Israel's prison service says the allegations are false.

entries.title: India's parody 'cockroach party' claims website has been blocked
entries.snippet: The satirical group has gained millions of followers as "the voice of the lazy and unemployed".

entries.title: SpaceX launches massive Starship V3 rocket on test flight
entries.snippet: The largest and most powerful rocket in history blasted off after its first attempted launch was postponed.

entries.title: Religious leaders, lawmakers push for $1 billion to secure houses of worship
entries.snippet: There's an effort on Capitol Hill to increase funding for the Nonprofit Security Grant Program, which awards funding to houses of worship to harden their defenses. In 2024, roughly a third of those who applied actually received funding.

entries.title: Nurse convicted in patient's death is now a national speaker on hospital safety
entries.snippet: RaDonda Vaught was convicted of negligent homicide after dispensing the wrong drug to a patient. She now gives speeches about hospital safety in an era of automation and artificial intelligence.

entries.title: Russia uses hypersonic Oreshnik missile in mass attack on Kyiv
entries.snippet: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Sunday Russia used the powerful hypersonic Oreshnik ballistic missile during a mass drone and missile attack on Kyiv on Sunday that killed at least two people.

entries.title: 'Homeland Security' has spawned political insecurity since DHS was born
entries.snippet: DHS was originally conceived in the interest of unity and harmony — and the phrase "homeland security" was originally meant to be reassuring.

entries.title: Torn by war, Israelis and Palestinians tie their fortunes together
entries.snippet: At a time when hopes are dim for resolving the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, some Arab and Jewish entrepreneurs are partnering across the divide, hoping to prove what's possible.

entries.title: The Enhanced Games are Sunday. Here's what to know about the controversial event
entries.snippet: Dozens of athletes — including former Olympians — will participate in the Las Vegas event while using performance-enhancing drugs.

entries.title: Suspect dead after opening fire near White House security checkpoint, Secret Service says
entries.snippet: A man who opened fire Saturday near a White House security checkpoint is dead after being shot by officers who returned fire, the U.S. Secret Service said. It was the third incidence of gunfire in the vicinity of President Donald Trump in the past month.

entries.title: Romanian director Cristian Mungiu's 'Fjord' wins top prize at Cannes
entries.snippet: Mungiu took home the prestigious Palme D'Or for his film Fjord , a culture-war drama set in Norway.

entries.title: Trump touts Iran breakthrough but details remain unclear
entries.snippet: President Trump announced the unfinalized deal on social media after talks with Israel and other allies. Iran did not officially confirm the deal, and state media contradicted parts of it.

entries.title: What will Trump do next with Iran?
entries.snippet: Three months since the start of its conflict with Iran, the Trump administration is oscillating between strike threats and diplomatic overtures. Neither path has yielded a clear resolution.

entries.title: Venezuelan opposition leader Machado says she will run again for presidency and return from exile by late 2026
entries.snippet: Venezuela's Nobel Peace Prize laureate María Corina Machado announced on Saturday that she plans to run for president again and intends to return to her home country before the end of 2026.

entries.title: Iran's soccer federation says its World Cup base camp has been moved to Mexico from the United States
entries.snippet: The president of the governing body of Iranian soccer said Saturday the nation's World Cup training base has been moved to Mexico from the United States after getting approval from FIFA.

entries.title: Marines conduct rapid response exercise at U.S. Embassy in Venezuela's capital
entries.snippet: Two Marine Corps Osprey aircraft, which have characteristics of both a helicopter and a fixed-wing airplane, flew over the recently reopened U.S. Embassy in Caracas.

entries.title: 40,000 under evacuation orders after chemical tank leak in Southern California
entries.snippet: Authorities in Southern California on Friday were racing to figure out how to prevent the explosion of a storage tank that has been leaking a hazardous chemical used to make plastic parts, as some 40,000 people were under evacuation orders in the area.

entries.title: Gunmen open fire in 2 separate attacks in Honduras, killing at least 25
entries.snippet: Gunmen opened fire in two separate attacks Thursday on the Honduran coast, killing at least 25 people, including six police officers, authorities said.

entries.title: Trump says deal with Iran, including opening Strait of Hormuz, is 'largely negotiated'
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump said Saturday that a deal with Iran on the war, including opening the Strait of Hormuz, has been "largely negotiated" after calls with Israel and other allies in the region.

entries.title: Kyle Busch died after severe pneumonia led to sepsis, his family says
entries.snippet: Kyle Busch died after severe pneumonia progressed into sepsis, resulting in rapid and overwhelming complications, according to a statement released by his family.

entries.title: Deadliest coal mine explosion in years kills at least 82 people in China, state media say
entries.snippet: A gas explosion at a coal mine in China's northern Shanxi province killed at least 82 people, local officials said Saturday, in what was the country's deadliest mining accident in recent years.

entries.title: Explosion at New York City shipyard kills 1 and injures 36, officials say
entries.snippet: One person has died after a fire and two explosions Friday at a New York City shipyard, officials say.

entries.title: Eighteen suspected Ebola patients escape after treatment tent is set on fire for a second time in Congo
entries.snippet: Angry residents of a town at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo attacked and burned a tent that was part of a health center where people are being treated for the virus, the staff there said Saturday.

entries.title: Is it time for the U.S. to reassess its Iran strategy?
entries.snippet: With talks stalled and Iran maintaining its chokehold over the Strait of Hormuz, President Trump is weighing whether to restart the war. Strikes failed to eliminate Iran's regime or destroy its military and nuclear capabilities, so is it time for the U.S. to reassess its strategy

entries.title: Tulsi Gabbard's record and impact on the U.S. intelligence community
entries.snippet: Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard, the highest-ranking intelligence official in the U.S. government, has resigned. She said her husband is suffering from a rare bone cancer that requires her full attention. Nick Schifrin and Liz Landers report, and William Brangham

entries.title: SpaceX launches its biggest Starship mega rocket yet on test flight
entries.snippet: It's the 12th test flight of the rocket that SpaceX is building to get people to Mars one day. But first comes the moon and NASA's Artemis program.

entries.title: News Wrap: Rubio meets with NATO allies amid troop level confusion
entries.snippet: In our news wrap Friday, Secretary of State Marco Rubio met with NATO allies amid confusion over recent statements on U.S. troop levels in Europe, authorities in the Democratic Republic of Congo are banning funeral wakes and large gatherings to try and slow the Ebola outbreak and

entries.title: Trump's Cuba strategy echoes his Venezuela playbook, but experts point out key differences
entries.snippet: Similar pressure campaigns do not equal similar results, experts say, even if President Donald Trump has often warned that "Cuba is next."

entries.title: What's behind the decade-long 'learning recession' for American students
entries.snippet: As the school year is coming to a close, a new analysis shines another harsh spotlight on what's being called a "learning recession" for American students. It's a problem that started long before the pandemic, according to the latest National Education Scorecard. William Brangham

entries.title: Shein's purchase of sustainable fashion brand Everlane sparks outcry
entries.snippet: A deal between two seemingly incompatible clothing brands is causing a lot of consternation among customers and raising questions about sustainable fashion. Shein, the Chinese fast-fashion giant, is acquiring Everlane. For many, Everlane has been the face of a sustainable and eth

entries.title: Shipyard fire and explosion on Staten Island injures at least 16, officials say
entries.snippet: Someone reported two workers trapped in a confined space at the dock at about 3:30 p.m. Friday, and responding firefighters found a fire burning in the basement of a large metal structure at the dock, said Joanne Mariano with the New York Fire Department's press office.

entries.title: Carbon credit program pays small landowners to keep forests standing
entries.snippet: Markets to offset carbon emissions are now worth about $2 billion annually, and supporters say they're a key tool to address climate change. But carbon credits have also been criticized for being opaque and not reducing emissions nearly enough. Stephanie Sy reports on an effort t

entries.title: Brooks and Capehart on Trump's loyalty demands
entries.snippet: David Brooks of The Atlantic and Jonathan Capehart of MS NOW join William Brangham to discuss the week in politics, including President Trump demonstrating his grip on Republican primary voters, another Cabinet member departs his administration and Democrats releasing a clumsy an

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: New Chinese surveillance leaves foreigners nowhere to hide
entries.snippet: A Chinese cybersecurity expert has revealed to DW details of China's new high-tech policing. From ski resort facial recognition to seats on a train, the system can track anyone and compile a "holistic profile."

entries.title: Russia uses hypersonic Oreshnik missile in Kyiv attack
entries.snippet: Russia carried out a massive drone and missile attack on the capital, Kyiv, and its surrounding region overnight, killing at least four people. France and Germany have condemned Moscow's use of the Oreshnik missile.

entries.title: Deadly blast hits train in Pakistan's Balochistan
entries.snippet: A blast on a train in Pakistan's Balochistan province has killed at least 24 people and injured dozens more. The explosion targeted military personnel and their families ahead of the Eid holiday.

entries.title: Philippines: 20 feared trapped after building collapse
entries.snippet: The building collapsed before dawn after a severe thunderstorm. Officials said rescuers reported "hearing voices" in the rubble.

entries.title: Germany news: Most doubt Bundeswehr military readiness — poll
entries.snippet: A new poll shows widespread doubts about Germany's defense readiness, with stronger fears over cyber threats than military attack. Meanwhile, a record number of people obtained a German passport in 2025. DW has more.

entries.title: Australia: Man dies of shark attack on eastern coast
entries.snippet: The man was bitten by a shark at Kennedy Shoal in Australia's northeastern state of Queensland, in the second shark attack in the country this month.

entries.title: Displaced Ukrainians risk home seizure under Russian law
entries.snippet: Russia is tightening control over property in occupied Ukrainian territories, requiring owners to register under Russian law. Many Ukrainians say returning to do so would put their safety and freedom at risk.

entries.title: Enhanced Games: Why 'crippling injuries' are the least of it
entries.snippet: Doping in sports is nothing new. Athletes at the Enhanced Games will know the risks — severe injury, even paralysis. But bioethicists are also concerned we're opening the gates to altering our fundamental human biology.

entries.title: Iran war: Donald Trump says deal 'largely negotiated'
entries.snippet: US Secretary of State Rubio has said an announcement on the deal could come as early as Sunday. Pakistan's top diplomat has cited "meaningful progress," while Israel's Netanyahu reportedly voiced concern. Follow DW.

entries.title: US: Suspect dies after gunfire near White House
entries.snippet: There was a massive police response after gunshots were fired near the White House, where President Donald Trump was working on a deal with Iran. The suspect has been shot and killed by law enforcement.

entries.title: Kane's hat trick seals Bayern Munich's 21st German Cup win
entries.snippet: Harry Kane scored three times to fire Bayern Munich to a 3-0 victory over Stuttgart in the German Cup final. The win delivered a domestic double for the Bavarian giants and ended a six-year trophy drought.

entries.title: Serbia: Police clash with protesters urging early elections
entries.snippet: Officers fired teargas and stun grenades as tens of thousands rallied against President Aleksandar Vucic's government. The demonstration went ahead despite the state rail operator canceling trains to and from Belgrade.

entries.title: Thousands rally in Madrid to demand Sanchez's resignation
entries.snippet: Mounting corruption allegations involving Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez’s family, allies and party sparked the protest.

entries.title: Cyprus election expected to shake up national politics
entries.snippet: Cyprus goes to the polls to elect a new parliament on Sunday. The vote is expected to reshape the country's political landscape, weaken traditional parties and accelerate the rise of new anti-establishment movements.

entries.title: Cheap attack drones break through Israel's Iron Dome
entries.snippet: Inexpensive fiber-optic drones are challenging Israel's high-tech defenses, shifting the military balance in the Middle East.

entries.title: Couple remanded in custody after boys found abandoned by road in Portugal
entries.snippet: A French woman is accused of abandoning her children in Portugal after reportedly blindfolding them and leading them into a wooded area during a game. Her French partner also faces charges.

entries.title: US, Iran strike upbeat tone as Hormuz deal takes shape
entries.snippet: US President Donald Trump flagged progress in talks with Iran, Tehran has warned that major gaps still stand in the way of dialing down the conflict.

entries.title: In Iran, internet access becomes a luxury for the few
entries.snippet: Despite the ongoing internet blockade in Iran, access to "Internet-Pro" is available to select groups for a fee. Access to information and communication is increasingly becoming a luxury.

entries.title: France bans Israel minister Ben-Gvir after flotilla video
entries.snippet: The Israeli far-right minister released a video taunting detained Gaza aid flotilla activists, prompting widespread criticism at home and internationally.
